source:
@@U04249@@
Thick darkness settles on the foe! Which way to turn, they do not know. Meteors crashing, blazing light, Dazzle and confound the sight! A marvelous view! But now, indeed, A shattering sound is all we need.

@@U04251@@
The empty armor from ancient vaults Finds itself revived in air. Their rattling, banging, clattering there Creates a discord without faults.

@@U04253@@
Quite right! They're not to be held back! Fighting wildly, whack on whack, The same as in the good old days. With greaves and armlets, and cuisses, too, Guelphs and Ghibellines renew Full tilt their neverending frays. Firm in inherited rancor, they put implacable hate on display. Now far and wide the tumult brays! And so, at every devil’s féte, Nothing succeeds like party hate, Down to the last convulsive throe. Wild sounds, that scatter fear and panic, Mingled with piercing yells Satanic, Ring down into the vale below. (Tumultuous warlike music in the orchestra, finally giving way to cheerful military music.)
translation:
@@U04249@@
浓浓的黑暗笼罩着敌人！该往哪边走，他们不知道。流星坠落，光芒四射，眼花缭乱！景色太棒了！但现在，确实，我们所需要的只是一声破碎的声音。

@@U04251@@
来自古代金库的空铠甲发现自己在空气中复活了。它们在那里发出嘎嘎声、撞击声、碰撞声，创造出一种毫无瑕疵的不和谐。

@@U04253@@
完全正确！他们不应该被阻止！狂战，打打，一如昔日的美好时光。圭尔夫派和吉伯林派也带着护胫、臂环和护腿，重新开始他们永无休止的争斗。他们怀着与生俱来的仇恨，将无法平息的仇恨表现出来。现在喧嚣四起！因此，在每一次魔鬼的盛宴上，没有什么比党派仇恨更成功的了，直到最后的痉挛性阵痛。狂野的声音，驱散恐惧和惊慌， 与撒旦般的刺耳叫喊混合在一起， 响彻下面的山谷。 （管弦乐队中喧闹的战争音乐，最后让位于欢快的军乐。）
